summary: REGRESSION TEST (frontend-only, mobile 390x844, public preview) of the paywall offerings fix. CRITICAL — USER BUG REPRODUCED: the paywall again shows 'Subscription options are unavailable right now / Tap to retry'. ROOT CAUSE confirmed at the RevenueCat API level: GET https://api.revenuecat.com/v1/subscribers/<id>/offerings (Bearer test_DVTXvbpqNHTxfpwfxYwOVtIgyNc) returns 200 with current_offering_id 'default' but packages: [] — ZERO packages attached to the offering. The products re-provisioning did NOT attach packages to the current offering (or wrote them to a different project). The app code behaves as designed (empty-state + Tap to retry). STRONG LEAD: frontend/.env now has NEW native keys (appl_OOwuZVkDjZgAvWfzbMvYOidPLTH / goog_EHrJSVHgTSOkfTYeqRJbRZNPWrR) from the user's new RC apps, but the SAME OLD Test Store key (test_DVTXvbpqNHTxfpwfxYwOVtIgyNc) — if products/offerings were provisioned in the NEW project, the web preview is still reading offerings from the OLD project; the test key likely needs rotating to the new project's test key. ALSO: the price upsert STILL never applied even on the old project (pro.monthly=999, pro.annual=7999 micros, trial:null — 3rd iteration observing this). WHAT PASSED: auth-gate OTP sign-in (fresh account auto-register + RC identity bind) PASS; Restore Purchases on fresh account shows 'No Active Subscription' with no error PASS; 'Tap to retry' is tappable and refetches PASS (but offerings stay empty). BLOCKED (same root cause): plan prices from store, monthly purchase, post-purchase entitlement/tabs, sign-out/sign-in offerings regression. CODE-HARDENING GAP: react-query retry:3 in revenuecat.tsx never fires for this failure mode because getOfferings() RESOLVES (HTTP 200, empty packages) — retry only triggers on rejected promises; only manual 'Tap to retry' recovers.

rca_of_issue: REPRODUCED user bug 'Subscription options are unavailable right now'. Reproduction: fresh account -> /subscription -> OTP sign-in -> plan step shows empty-state + fallback prices; console '[Purchases] Empty offerings'. RCA: GET /v1/subscribers/<id>/offerings (current test key) returns current_offering_id 'default' with packages: [] — the products re-provisioning (proxy /products upsert) created/updated PRODUCT records but never attached PACKAGE records to the current offering (or provisioned a different project than the one the unchanged test key belongs to; new appl_/goog_ keys + unchanged test key support the project-mismatch theory). Mitigation: attach $rc_monthly/$rc_annual packages to the default offering in the correct RC project (and/or rotate the test key), verify via the offerings curl above, restart expo, then retest. Secondary: the claimed price/trial upsert ($12.99/$89.99, P1W) has never verifiably applied (3 iterations) — always GET-verify after provisioning; POST 200 is not proof. Code-level hardening note: react-query retry:3 does not cover empty-200 offerings responses.
